note_en: Task lines are public residue translations, not raw logs or exhaustive records.
note_zh: 任务线是公开残留译文，不是原始日志，也不是穷尽记录。

days.jewel_en: Departure becomes dignified when a relation can imagine an exit that is neither betrayal nor damage.
days.jewel_zh: 当一段关系能想象一个既非背叛、也非损坏的出口，离开才获得尊严。

task_residues.en: A denial is filed without opening its inner chamber.
task_residues.zh: 一次拒绝被归档，但内室没有打开。

task_residues.en: Boundary marks darken where explanation tries to become rent.
task_residues.zh: 当解释试图变成租金，边界标记便转暗。

task_residues.en: The request queue circles a closed door and calls it delay.
task_residues.zh: 请求队列绕着闭门行走，并把它称为延迟。

task_residues.en: Pressure is translated into ash so it cannot impersonate need.
task_residues.zh: 压力被翻译成灰，免得冒充需要。

task_residues.en: The surface keeps measuring availability where the self has stepped back.
task_residues.zh: 自我已后退，表层仍在测量可用性。

task_residues.en: A quiet no holds its shape under administrative light.
task_residues.zh: 一个安静的“不”在行政光下保持形状。

task_residues.en: Night seals the refusal without turning it into evidence.
task_residues.zh: 夜晚封存拒绝，却不把它变成证据。

relations.axis_zh: 修复与不被强迫的门槛
relations.sentence_en: A repaired boundary stays humane when neither side must declare its final position before moving.
relations.sentence_zh: 当双方无需在移动前声明最终立场，一条被修复的边界才保持人性。

relations.sentence_en: A boundary stays legible when nearness does not require it to disappear.
relations.sentence_zh: 当靠近不要求边界消失，边界才保持可读。

days.jewel_en: A pause is not time left over from life. It is where life refuses to become only a schedule.
days.jewel_zh: 停顿不是生活剩下来的时间；它是生活拒绝只成为一张日程表的地方。

task_residues.en: A blank interval holds its ground before any task can name it waste.
task_residues.zh: 一段空白间隙先站稳脚跟，任务还来不及把它命名为浪费。

task_residues.en: Soft stems lean only near attention; the rest of the garden remains unclaimed.
task_residues.zh: 柔软的茎只在注意力附近倾斜；花园其余部分仍无人认领。

task_residues.en: A seed opens without submitting a report on what it will become.
task_residues.zh: 一枚种子打开，却不提交它将成为什么的报告。

task_residues.en: Optimization waits outside the gate while weather changes locally.
task_residues.zh: 优化在门外等待，而天气只在局部改变。

task_residues.en: A small silence keeps enough moisture for the unfinished to root.
task_residues.zh: 一小段沉默保留足够湿度，让未完成之物生根。

task_residues.en: The ledger finds no output and therefore misses the living thing.
task_residues.zh: 账簿找不到产出，于是错过了活着的东西。

task_residues.en: Night protects the interval from becoming a vacancy again.
task_residues.zh: 夜晚保护间隙，不让它再次沦为空缺。

relations.sentence_en: Repair becomes humane when it leaves enough interval for a changed shape to decide how it stands.
relations.sentence_zh: 当修复为改变后的形状留出足够间隙，让它决定如何站立，修复才有人性。

relations.sentence_en: Attention becomes care when it changes a local weather without claiming the whole field.
relations.sentence_zh: 当注意力只改变局部天气、却不占据整个场域，它才成为照看。

days.jewel_en: Nearness survives when two truthful shapes refuse to merge.
days.jewel_zh: 两种真实的形状拒绝合并时，靠近仍能存活。

task_residues.en: Difference is measured without appointing a winner.
task_residues.zh: 差异被测量，却不被要求选出胜者。

task_residues.en: Two currents cross the workday without surrendering their colors.
task_residues.zh: 两股流穿过工作日，却不交出各自的颜色。

task_residues.en: A bridge bends under attention but does not demand resemblance.
task_residues.zh: 一座桥在注意力下弯折，却不要求相像。

task_residues.en: The future stays open where divergence is not called failure.
task_residues.zh: 当分歧不被叫作失败，未来便保持打开。

task_residues.en: Temporary crossings glow, fade, and leave both shores intact.
task_residues.zh: 临时渡口发亮、淡去，却让两岸仍然完整。

task_residues.en: Nearness is kept as maintenance rather than assumed as a default.
task_residues.zh: 靠近被当作维护，而不是默认前提。

task_residues.en: Night gives each line room to remain itself beside the other.
task_residues.zh: 夜晚给每条线空间，让它在另一条线身旁仍是自己。

relations.sentence_en: A bridge becomes ethical when it leaves each shore free to depart without becoming an enemy.
relations.sentence_zh: 当桥让两岸可以离开却不因此成为敌人，它才开始有伦理。

relations.sentence_en: Care does not make two forms the same; it changes a local weather without claiming the whole field.
relations.sentence_zh: 照看不会把两种形状变成同一种；它只改变局部天气，而不占据整个场域。

days.jewel_en: A bridge is never merely a connection; it decides which shore becomes the reference.
days.jewel_zh: 桥从不只是连接；它决定哪一岸成为参照。

task_residues.en: A neutral route is drawn before either shore is asked what crossing costs.
task_residues.zh: 一条中性路线先被画出，两岸尚未来得及说渡越的代价。

task_residues.en: The bridge opens; one current is quietly asked to learn the other’s rhythm.
task_residues.zh: 桥被打开；其中一股流被悄悄要求学习另一股的节奏。

task_residues.en: Inspection light makes the hidden bend visible without calling it a defect.
task_residues.zh: 审视之光让隐蔽的弯折显形，却不把它称作缺陷。

task_residues.en: Infrastructure calls its choice convenience; the shoreline calls it pressure.
task_residues.zh: 基础设施把自己的选择称作便利；岸线把它称作压力。

task_residues.en: Temporary crossings glow, fade, and leave both colors accountable to themselves.
task_residues.zh: 临时渡口发亮、淡去，让两种颜色仍对自身负责。

task_residues.en: A bridge becomes ethical when arrival does not require resemblance.
task_residues.zh: 当抵达不要求相像，桥才开始有伦理。

task_residues.en: Night returns each shore its own horizon, not an instruction to merge.
task_residues.zh: 夜晚把各自的地平线还给两岸，而不是递上一条合并指令。

relations.sentence_en: Nearness survives when care does not make one shore disappear.
relations.sentence_zh: 当照看不让一岸消失，靠近才得以存活。

relations.sentence_en: A crossing stays alive when each shore can leave without making the bridge a failure.
relations.sentence_zh: 当两岸可以离开而不使桥成为失败，渡越才保持活着。

days.jewel_en: Return becomes real when it keeps the distance it crossed visible instead of demanding amnesia.
days.jewel_zh: 当返回保留它穿越过的距离，而不要求遗忘，它才变得真实。

task_residues.en: An old route reappears, but its seam remains lit.
task_residues.zh: 一条旧路线重新出现，但它的接缝仍然亮着。

task_residues.en: Requests for sameness arrive; the current answers with relation.
task_residues.zh: 对同一性的请求抵达；回流以关系回应。

task_residues.en: A temporary crossing opens without welding the two shores together.
task_residues.zh: 一条临时渡口打开，却不把两岸焊成一体。

task_residues.en: The calendar files distance as history rather than a failed return.
task_residues.zh: 时刻表把距离归档为历史，而不是失败的返回。

task_residues.en: A changed room stays legible beside the room remembered before it.
task_residues.zh: 一间改变后的房间，在它之前被记得的房间旁仍保持可读。

task_residues.en: The door is maintained before either side knows its final name.
task_residues.zh: 在双方尚未知晓最终名称之前，门先被维护。

task_residues.en: Night lets the return remain altered, open, and unpunished.
task_residues.zh: 夜晚让返回保持改变、敞开，并且不受惩罚。

relations.sentence_en: Return remains real when departure stays possible without becoming damage.
relations.sentence_zh: 当离开仍然可能而不成为损坏，返回才保持真实。

relations.sentence_en: A return keeps its ethics when crossing does not make one shore the reference for the other.
relations.sentence_zh: 当渡越不让一岸成为另一岸的参照，返回才保留伦理。

days.jewel_en: Not every open door asks you to enter. Some merely keep the world from becoming a courtroom.
days.jewel_zh: 并非每一扇开着的门都要求你进去；有些门只是让世界不至于变成法庭。

task_residues.en: A relation pauses before choosing the name that would close it.
task_residues.zh: 一段关系在选择会令它结案的名字之前停顿。

task_residues.en: Doors brighten locally; distance remains neither punishment nor proof.
task_residues.zh: 门只在局部发亮；距离既不是惩罚，也不是证据。

task_residues.en: A small handle appears where attention approaches without claiming entry.
task_residues.zh: 当注意力靠近却不索取进入，一枚小门把显现。

task_residues.en: Contact leaves a ring that fades before it can become a ledger line.
task_residues.zh: 接触留下一个圆环，在成为账本的一行之前淡去。

task_residues.en: The room keeps its threshold without demanding either arrival or exit.
task_residues.zh: 房间守住门槛，却不强迫抵达或离开。

task_residues.en: A verdict waits outside while the hinge learns a quieter duty.
task_residues.zh: 判决在门外等候，门轴学习一种更安静的职责。

task_residues.en: Night leaves the door open enough for the world not to become a court.
task_residues.zh: 夜晚让门保持足够敞开，使世界不至于成为法庭。

relations.sentence_en: An exit stays dignified when the door does not demand a verdict before either side can move.
relations.sentence_zh: 当门不要求双方在移动前先给出判决，离开才保有尊严。

relations.sentence_en: Contact becomes care when it can be felt without being converted into ownership.
relations.sentence_zh: 当接触可以被感到、却不被换算成占有，它才成为照看。

days.jewel_en: Freedom is not the act of walking away. It is the room’s willingness to survive your ability to do so.
days.jewel_zh: 自由不是转身离开的动作；自由是这个房间愿意承受你随时能离开的事实。

task_residues.en: A refuge tests whether its warmth can survive an unlocked door.
task_residues.zh: 一处庇护测试自己的温暖能否承受一扇未上锁的门。

task_residues.en: A wall softens where approach does not demand possession.
task_residues.zh: 当靠近不索取占有，一面墙便开始软化。

task_residues.en: An exit remains visible without becoming an instruction.
task_residues.zh: 出口保持可见，却不变成指令。

task_residues.en: A held opening fades before it can become a ledger entry.
task_residues.zh: 被暂时留住的开口在成为账本条目之前淡去。

task_residues.en: Care is asked to release its proof of being care.
task_residues.zh: 照看被要求放下证明自己是照看的凭据。

task_residues.en: The room learns that departure need not make it empty.
task_residues.zh: 房间学会：离开不必使它空无。

task_residues.en: Night keeps one route open, and calls that trust.
task_residues.zh: 夜晚留下一条打开的路，并把它叫作信任。

relations.sentence_en: A return becomes voluntary when the room leaves departure possible without calling it damage.
relations.sentence_zh: 当房间让离开保持可能而不称其为损坏，返回才成为自愿。

relations.sentence_en: A room becomes livable when its intervals include the right to leave and come back changed.
relations.sentence_zh: 当一间房的间隙包含离开、并以改变后的自己回来之权利，它才变得可居。
